title: Glowing slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD84A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9A1F'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='40' ry='38' fill='#FFB020' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='28' ry='27' fill='#FFC24A' opacity='0.22'/>
  <!-- crust: big outer triangle -->
  <path d='M50 12 L88 84 Q52 92 16 84 Z' fill='#E8A94E'/>
  <!-- crust inner lighter rim -->
  <path d='M50 12 L88 84 Q52 92 16 84 Z' fill='#F0BE6A' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- crust edge highlight (top of slice) -->
  <path d='M50 12 L68 60 Q50 63 32 60 Z' fill='#F7D08A' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- sauce layer -->
  <path d='M50 26 L80 80 Q50 87 20 80 Z' fill='#E8452B'/>
  <!-- cheese layer -->
  <path d='M50 34 L74 76 Q50 82 26 76 Z' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- cheese drips -->
  <path d='M26 76 Q24 84 30 86 Q35 84 34 77 Z' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <path d='M74 76 Q78 85 71 86 Q66 83 67 76 Z' fill='#FFC93C'/>
  <path d='M50 82 Q51 90 46 90 Q43 86 45 81 Z' fill='#FFB92E'/>
  <!-- pepperoni -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='7' fill='#C2301C'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='4' fill='#E4502F'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='6.5' fill='#C2301C'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='3.6' fill='#E4502F'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='5.5' fill='#C2301C'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='3' fill='#E4502F'/>
  <!-- herb sprinkles -->
  <rect x='52' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3FA34D' transform='rotate(20 54 45)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='56' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3FA34D' transform='rotate(-30 32 57)'/>
  <rect x='64' y='50' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3FA34D' transform='rotate(45 66 51)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='70' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3FA34D' transform='rotate(-15 50 71)'/>
</svg>
